findings.title: Owner-session loss does not cancel an in-flight local read
findings.detail: The design says to recheck the owner session before publishing and to kill children on cancellation, but the existing session lifecycle (`src/SoFa.Modules.Workspace/Identity/OwnerSessions.cs:154-177`) has no cancellation signal for local work when a session expires or is removed. `RequestAborted` alone does not fire when the owner logs out in another request. A Node/Git helper can therefore continue reading configured private paths after authorization is revoked, even if its response is ultimately discarded.
findings.minimal_fix: Link host-reader cancellation to session lifetime (add and cancel a session-scoped token on removal/expiry), and test logout/expiry during a blocked helper: the process tree must stop and no result may publish.

findings.title: Bounded individual reads still permit unbounded concurrent refresh work
findings.detail: The local route can launch work for up to ten registrations and ten checkouts, while concurrent explicit refreshes have no specified admission/concurrency cap. GitHub refreshes can likewise overlap across requests. Per-command time/output limits do not bound aggregate child processes, API calls, or memory under repeated requests. The existing transport and session guards provide cancellation/authority safety, not refresh serialization or a concurrency budget.
findings.minimal_fix: Specify and implement a small per-session or global in-flight refresh limit (including child-process fan-out), with defined coalescing/rejection behavior; test concurrent refreshes and cancellation without exceeding the cap.

dimensions.name: Acceptance criteria
dimensions.evidence: Tasks 1-4 and the runtime-inventory scenarios cover the explicit first slice; future capacity/usage criteria are honestly deferred.

dimensions.name: Implementation completeness
dimensions.evidence: Tasks 1-4.4 cover implementation, integration, spec synchronization and limitations; no implementation is claimed.

dimensions.name: Tests
dimensions.evidence: Design 41-46 and tasks 1-4 include source, .NET and browser tests, but omit owner-session-loss cancellation and concurrent refresh bounds.

dimensions.name: Quality checks
dimensions.evidence: Design 47 and task 4.3 require full npm verification and hosted CI; not evidence that they have run.

dimensions.name: Security
dimensions.evidence: Separation, fixed read-only sources, redaction and GitHub authority are specified; session-loss cancellation during local reads is missing.

dimensions.name: Architecture / design conformance
dimensions.evidence: Design uses the existing Workspace/ADR-0006 observer boundary and does not add execution or persistence authority.

dimensions.name: Documentation
dimensions.evidence: Task 4.2 calls for architecture, README and configuration documentation updates.

dimensions.name: Product / spec consistency
dimensions.evidence: Cited accepted product nodes and proposed runtime-inventory spec are included; broader health/usage is not claimed.

dimensions.name: Evidence
dimensions.evidence: Design 46-47 and task 4.3 require actual selected-host observations, safe receipts, CI and explicit source limitations.

dimensions.name: Human review
dimensions.evidence: Task 4.3 requires fresh independent final-head review; configured reviewer remains distinct and protected gates are retained.

dimensions.name: Known limitations
dimensions.evidence: Proposal 28, design 11/46 and task 4.4 explicitly defer capacity, usage, process health and other future scope.
